name: trademe_jobs-mcp
description: Trade Me Jobs (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_trademe_jobs_consumer_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_JOBS_CONSUMER_KEY
platform_mcp_trademe_jobs_consumer_key.description: Trade Me application consumer key (My Trade Me > My applications).

platform_mcp_trademe_jobs_oauth_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_JOBS_OAUTH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_trademe_jobs_oauth_token.description: Member access token from the OAuth 1.0a flow (Trade Me access tokens do not expire).

platform_mcp_trademe_jobs_oauth_token_se.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_JOBS_OAUTH_TOKEN_SECRET
platform_mcp_trademe_jobs_oauth_token_se.description: Access token secret from the same flow.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/MyTradeMe/Summary.json ('Permission Required: MyTradeMeRead') returns the MemberSummary (MemberId, Nickname, ...).

tools.name: search
tools.description: GET /v1/Search/Jobs.json: search_string ('One or more keywords'), page ('starting from 1'), rows (max 500 when authenticated). location is not sent because Trade Me filters by numeric region / district ids (see the Localities catalogue). company, Region and StartDate (/Date(ms)/) come per job; JobType, District, Category and pay details stay in raw; description is the PayBenefits text.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /v1/Listings/{listingId}.json: the full listing (Body, Attributes with job details, Agency for agency-posted jobs, ShortDescription).
